english.title: Manufacturer of electrical equipment fail to draw up single declaration of conformity
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a manufacturer of electrical equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), which was subject to more than one EU instrument requiring a declaration of conformity to be drawn up, failed to draw up a single declaration of conformity which identified the EU instruments and included references to the publication of those EU instruments in the Official Journal
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(3), 50(1) and 51(1) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
